host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: git diff HEAD~1 --stat; git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs crates/athena-core/src/store.rs

git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs crates/athena-agent crates/athena-cli/src CHANGELOG.md xtask crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs crates/athena-cli/tests/live.rs crates/athena-core/tests
git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-agent CHANGELOG.md xtask crates/athena-core/tests crates/athena-cli/tests/live.rs

git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs
git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-cli/src crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs crates/athena-context
git status --short; ls -la --time-style=full-iso crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs
git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- athena.toml defaults.toml .github records

policy_denials.detail: git grep -n "fn unlock_dir\|fn remove_tree\|chattr" -- crates | head -30; git grep -n "remove_tree\|remove_dir_all" -- crates/athena-core/src | grep -v "tests\|test" | head -40

cargo build -p athena-agent -p athena-git -p athena-context -p athena-core -p athena-cli --config 'profile.dev.package.athena-agent.codegen-units=255' --config 'profile.dev.package.athena-git.codegen-units=255' --config 'profile.dev.package.athena-context.codegen-units=255' --config 'profile.dev.package.athena-core.codegen-units=255' --config 'profile.dev.package.athena-cli.codegen-units=255'
